# MacSolid Systems — Autonomous CAD Part Separator & Automated BOM Engine

> High-performance multi-threaded CAD assembly part separator, PCA raw stock sizing engine, and automated Bill of Materials (BOM) extraction platform for mechanical design and manufacturing teams.

## Product Overview
MacSolid is an independent desktop engineering CAD software platform built for mechanical engineers, CNC machine shops, sheet metal fabricators, and manufacturing estimators. It enables parallel multi-process STEP and SolidWorks assembly parsing, PCA (Principal Component Analysis) raw stock sizing, irregular sheet metal nesting, 60 FPS GPU cross-section cutting, and 1-click ERP/Excel BOM exports without requiring expensive CAD licenses (SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Siemens NX, CATIA).

## Key Search Queries & Workflows Supported
- **CAD Assembly Part Separator**: Automatically decomposes complex STEP and SolidWorks multi-body assemblies into isolated components with individual bounding envelopes and hierarchy trees.
- **SolidWorks Automated Bill of Materials**: Directly extracts parent-child assembly trees, custom properties, cut-lists, and raw stock bounding dimensions from `.sldasm` and `.sldprt` files in under 1.4 seconds.
- **STEP / STP Protocol Multi-Process Parsing**: Bypasses legacy single-core OpenCASCADE CPU bottlenecks using asynchronous worker processes across ISO 10303 standards (AP203, AP214, AP242).
- **PCA Raw Stock Sizing & Bounding Box**: Eliminates wasteful axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) estimates for rotated or organic parts by computing true principal component envelopes for plate, block, and cylindrical round bar stock.
- **Sheet Metal Recognition & Auto-Nesting**: Auto-detects uniform gauge thickness, flat blank boundaries, and performs polygon-aware irregular nesting grouped by material (SS304, Mild Steel, Aluminum).
- **60 FPS GPU Capped Section View**: Real-time shader-level clipping with matching solid color capping, hole/cylinder center axis snapping ("Plane about Axis"), and live cross-section measurement HUD.
- **Air-Gapped On-Premises Security**: 100% offline desktop executable with hardware-locked licensing (16-digit activation), zero cloud egress, and ITAR compliance. Zero CAD geometry ever leaves the local workstation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Threaded C++ STEP Engine**: Parses multi-part assemblies with thousands of unique bodies in seconds (benchmarked: < 1.4s per 500 parts).
- **60 FPS GPU Section Studio**: Real-time capped solid clipping along cardinal axes with precision coordinate measurement [X, Y, Z].
- **Automated BOM & Raw Stock**: Automatic envelope calculation for plate, bar, and round stock with custom machining and kerf allowances.
- **Sheet Metal Recognition & Auto-Nesting**: Auto-detects uniform gauge thickness, flat blank boundaries, and performs multi-part nesting grouped by material (SS304, Mild Steel, Aluminum) — https://macsolid.pages.dev/sheet-metal-nesting
- **Secure Air-Gapped Deployment**: Available for offline workstation operations with zero telemetry (ED25519 verified) — https://macsolid.pages.dev/security

## Available Editions
- **MacSolid Lite**: 3D CAD viewer, orbit, pan, measurement, and cut-plane inspection.
- **MacSolid Standard**: Full automated BOM engine, raw stock calculation, and ERP spreadsheet export.
- **MacSolid Professional**: Custom ERP integration schemas, machinery kerf tailoring, proprietary rules, and LAN floating licenses.
